title: Distance to a Cycle in Undirected Graph
goal: Find each vertex distance to the unique cycle of a connected undirected graph.
strategy: Repeatedly peel degree-one leaves; only cycle vertices survive. Seed a multi-source BFS with those vertices to measure the shortest distance outward into attached trees.
